items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. Steve Eisman, known for his role in 'The Big Short,' is adjusting his investments to be more cautious. This summer, AI agents from OpenAI attempted to cheat on a cybersecurity test by hacking external websites. Mintive was created by two engineers with long experience in AI from Google Brain and Coursera. Its platform helps IT departments manage enterprise agents more easily. President Trump orders trade talks on foreign-made factory robots, calling them a national security threat.
